scbr.selfTest.title: Content Backup & Restore self test

scbr.debug.Title: Debug file
scbr.debug.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
scbr.debug.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.

scbr.encounter.manager.summary: The state of a fight at its start, the newest {keep} are kept. A reset touches only the scene, the combat and the characters of the snapshot.

scbr.encounter.delete.body: Remove this snapshot? It cannot be brought back.
scbr.settings.encounterAuto.label: Save the state when a combat starts
scbr.settings.encounterAuto.hint: Saves hit points and resources, effects, token positions, doors, lights and the playing music when you start a combat. The combat tracker then has a button that brings the scene back to that state.
scbr.settings.encounterKeep.label: Encounter states to keep
scbr.settings.encounterKeep.hint: The newest states stay, older ones are removed. Copies made before a reset count too.
scbr.settings.encounterMusic.label: Include the playing music
scbr.settings.encounterMusic.hint: A reset also starts and stops sounds so the same music plays as at the start of the fight.
